workItems.title: [Report Designer] Link report fields to variables
workItems.description:
As a Report Author
I want to link report fields to variables in the web Report Designer
So that my report templates pull live values from the correct regime and calculation run without manual re-entry

Size estimate: TBD � shell created for estimation
Sequencing note: None

Requirements

Browse/filter variables
Author selects a Regime from a dropdown to scope the variable tree to that regime's variable set. Author can toggle between "All" (every available variable) and "Linked" (only variables already linked somewhere in the current template) to filter the tree view. Author can also search/filter by text.

Create a link
Author can browse variables (scoped/filtered as above) and create a link from a variable to a cell or cell range in the template, as a web-appropriate equivalent of the WPF drag-to-link interaction.

Variable categories
Author can link both economic output variables (e.g. Cash Flow, Royalty) and report metadata pseudo-variables (e.g. Calculation Settings, Comparison Calculation Settings, Report Options, Project Settings/Dates, Discount Settings, Comments, Incremental Project Info) through the same linking mechanism � both categories appear in the same variable tree regardless of report type (Standard Report or One Line Summary Report).

Flat metadata leaves
Most pseudo-variables are flat, single-value leaves, for example:
  • Project Settings: Project Name, Regime Currency, Regime Name, Revision Date, Revision Tag, Scenario, Was Linked to Dataflow
  • Project Dates: Duration, Economic Limit, End Year, Inflation Date, Start Year
  • Discount Settings: Discount Date, Discount Method (Discount Rates are a separate linking mechanism � see 1869369)
  • Comments: Comments (a specific linkable variable, not just a UI label)
  • Calculation Settings: Currency Deck, Last Calculated, Price Deck, Price Scenario, Results Set Name, Results Set Run, Run Project Scenario
  • Comparison Calculation Settings: mirrors Calculation Settings for a comparison run (Comparison Currency Deck, Comparison Last Calculated, Comparison Price Deck, Comparison Price Scenario, Comparison Results Set Name, Comparison Results Set Run, Comparison Run Project Scenario). Dev note: these fields exist to support Variance and Multi-run report generation modes in Calculate & Analyze (Result Sets) � the template holds placeholders for a second/comparison run's context; the actual variance/multi-run calculation and execution happens outside this Feature's scope (report execution, not template design).
  • Report Options: Currency & Discounting Preset Name, Do not apply discounting prior to Discount Date, Report Inflation Date, Reporting Currency Deck, Use Hierarchy Currency, Values prior to Inflation Date are Nominal
  • Incremental Project Info: Calculation Method, Group, Order, Tab, Type. Dev note: an incremental calculation returns a project's value relative to the project ranked before it in a defined sequence; the sequencing/method settings themselves are configured at the hierarchy folder level, outside the Report Designer � these fields just expose that configuration's metadata for display in a report.

Related but separate stories
Discount Rates (1869369) and Ranges � Date Range/Formula Range (1869339) behave differently from simple variable linking (live calculation inputs / injected structural content, respectively) and are scoped as their own stories rather than covered here.

Read-only link attributes
Variable Name, Variable Prompt, and Variable Type display read-only on a link, inherited from the variable definition � not editable from the link itself.

Configurable link attributes
Author can configure Working Interest, Real/Nominal, Type (Values), Discount Rate, and Placeholder Run on an existing link without recreating it. Placeholder Run lets a link target a specific calculation run, so a template can reference multiple runs/sensitivities side-by-side.

Unlink
Author can remove a link from a cell/range, clearing the association.
